title: Thalattu Padava
desc: Raja, an educated young man, works as a driver for a rich client and gets harassed by his granddaughter. When she realises how learned he is, she falls in love with him and wishes to marry him.

title: Veera Padhakkam
desc: A corrupt, ambitious policeman is forced to mend his ways after witnessing the consequences of his role in a relative's life.

title: Karpura Mullai
desc: Maya finds her long-lost mother, who is a popular singer. Her mother refuses to reveal her father's identity and instead decides to publicly declare Maya as her daughter.

title: Enga Chinna Rasa
desc: Chinnarasu, a naive boy loves his stepmother dearly and fails to see her evil actions as she takes advantage of him. Later, she plots to kill him for his property.
